tool_args.rationale: All five observations are positive and have H≤0.48, far short of the H=22 forecast target. The slow-horizon probe tests whether gain reverses near the target and constrains the slow adaptation term before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: At short horizons, slow adaptation is constrained mainly through its initial slope, leaving its amplitude and timescale poorly separated for forecasting at H=22.
Finer short-time sampling can resolve fast transients but does not directly test late reversal.

considered_alternatives.option: Monotone Arrhenius or static sink-threshold model
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Neither predicts a horizon-driven sign reversal at fixed inputs; positive short-horizon observations alone cannot settle that distinction.
